name: Sunscreen & Aftersun Cream - Disaar Vitamin C Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++ 50gm Oil Free Sunscreen Instant High Protection Sunblock Cream
description:
Disaar Vitamin C Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++ – 50g

Protect and nourish your skin with the Disaar Vitamin C Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++. This oil-free, high-protection sunblock cream shields your skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays while keeping it moisturized, radiant, and healthy. Suitable for all skin types, including slightly sensitive skin, it also helps prevent premature aging and sun-induced damage.

Key Features & Benefits:

High Sun Protection: SPF50 PA+++ blocks UVA and UVB rays, preventing sunburn, tanning, and premature aging.

Vitamin C Enriched: Provides nutrients to brighten skin and enhance natural radiance.

Moisturizing & Non-Drying: Keeps skin hydrated while protecting against peeling and dryness.

Waterproof & Sweat-Resistant: Ideal for outdoor activities, swimming, and sports.

Suitable for All Skin Types: Gentle enough for slightly sensitive skin.

How to Use: Apply an appropriate amount evenly on the face before going outdoors and gently massage until fully absorbed. Reapply as needed for continuous protection.

Net Weight: 50g
Brand: Disaar
Country of Manufacture: P.R.C

Stay protected, hydrated, and radiant under the sun with Disaar Vitamin C Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++.
